{
  "name": "difnote",
  "version": "0.3.0",
  "description": "Review the diff of what changed in the folders Claude works in since you last looked, write a note on any line or hunk, and get your notes in the prompt to edit and send back",
  "author": {
    "name": "Mark Medum Bundgaard",
    "url": "https://github.com/mmedum"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/mmedum/difnote",
  "repository": "https://github.com/mmedum/difnote",
  "license": "Apache-2.0",
  "icon": "./.claude-plugin/icon.png",
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/mmedum/difnote#readme",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/mmedum/difnote/issues",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://github.com/mmedum/difnote#privacy",
  "userConfig": {
    "fileIcons": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "File icons",
      "description": "A Nerd Font icon before each file, in its language's color; turn off if your terminal's font has none",
      "default": true
    },
    "addedColor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Added color",
      "description": "How many lines a file or hunk adds: a theme role such as success (the default) or diffAddedWord, or a color: #7ccf8a, rgb(124,207,138), ansi256(114) or ansi:green",
      "default": "success"
    },
    "removedColor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Removed color",
      "description": "How many lines a file or hunk removes: a theme role such as error (the default) or diffRemovedWord, or a color: #e06c75, rgb(224,108,117), ansi256(167) or ansi:red",
      "default": "error"
    },
    "noteColor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Note color",
      "description": "Your notes in the pane: a theme role such as suggestion (the default), claude or warning, or a color: #7aa2f7, rgb(122,162,247), ansi256(110) or ansi:cyan",
      "default": "suggestion"
    },
    "cursorColor": {
      "type": "string",
